chunks: And from one of them (peace be upon him) he said:
Verily, the sins of a believer are forgiven, so the believer makes a fresh start; but this is only for the people of faith.

key_terms.يَسْتَأْنِفُ: makes a fresh start / begins anew

ai.seo_question: What is the status of a believer's sins and who is eligible for this forgiveness?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kitab al-Mumin* highlights the theological principle that the believer's sins are not merely forgiven but are effectively erased, allowing for a spiritual reset. The Imam clarifies that this exclusive privilege of continuous renewal is reserved strictly for *ahl al-iman*, distinguishing true believers from others who may perform similar acts but lack the foundational faith required for such divine mercy.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 82. It has been narrated that one of them (al-Baqir or al-Sadiq (a.s)) said:
Verily, the sins of a believer are forgiven. So, let the believer make a fresh start. But this privilege is only for the people of faith (ahl al-iman).
